## 1. UI8 Curated Listing Copy

- **Product Title**: Petika — Single Page Portfolio & Case Study Showcase (Dark & Light Theme)
- **Category**: Web Templates / Portfolios & Resumes
- **Pricing**: $38 (Personal) / $98 (Commercial Unlimited)
- **Key Tags**: portfolio, single page, bento grid, dark theme, light theme, product designer, case study, creative technologist, resume, bootstrap 5

### Short Description
An elite, responsive single-page portfolio template featuring Neo-Editorial Bento Grid layouts, zero-FOUT dual theme switching, and in-page case study modals. Built on Bootstrap 5.3.3 and pure Vanilla JS.

### Long Description
Petika is engineered for senior product designers, creative technologists, frontend architects, and design consultants who need a high-converting digital storefront that wins high-ticket retainers and recruiter interviews in under 45 seconds.

Instead of fragmenting your narrative across multiple pages, Petika brings your entire story into an editorial Bento Grid. Visitors can toggle between an immersive Obsidian & Amber Dark Mode and a crisp Alabaster Gallery Light Mode, inspect deep case studies via interactive modal viewports, filter projects instantly, and initiate inquiries with zero friction.

### Feature Highlights:
- **Neo-Editorial Bento Architecture**: Asymmetrical modular grid cards with 24px radii and tactile ambient elevation.
- **Zero-FOUT Dual Theme Switcher**: Instant Dark & Light mode toggle with pre-render localStorage persistence.
- **Interactive In-Page Case Study Modals**: Showcase briefs, challenge vs solution comparisons, impact metrics, and tech stacks without page reloads.
- **Pure Vanilla JS Category Filter**: Instant category switching (All, Product Design, Web Engineering, Mobile Apps, Brand Systems) with zero jQuery.
- **1-Click Copy Contact Pills**: Copy email, phone, or location directly to clipboard with instant confirmation badges.
- **Client-Side Validated Contact Form**: Built-in validation, anti-spam honeypot, loading spinner, and success banner.
- **100% WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance**: Audited contrast ratios (minimum 4.8:1 up to 18.2:1) and visible focus rings.
- **6-Viewport Tested**: Pixel-perfect reflow from 375px mobile to 1920px 4K displays with 0px horizontal scroll.

## 3. Creative Market Listing Copy

- **Product Title**: Petika Single Page Portfolio (Dark & Light)
- **Category**: Templates / Websites / Creative Portfolio
- **Price**: $29 Standard / $79 Extended Commercial

### Buyer Customization Pitch
Rebrand your portfolio in 60 seconds! Simply edit two hex variables (`--amber-500` and `--amber-600`) in `assets/css/style.css` to completely transform the color hierarchy. No npm, no Node.js, and no build setup required. Just double-click `index.html` to launch!
